name: Snow removal

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Rock salt, a quarter-yard
services.story: The main story: a quarter-yard of rock salt, $35, loaded into Alex's pickup. Nothing is taken: a YES books the load-out. Alex pays at the counter.

services.name: Salt-sand mix, a half-yard
services.story: A half-yard of salt-sand mix, $55, paid in full when booking, so it's set aside on a storm-rush day.

services.name: Salt by weight
services.story: Salt by weight: a trailer load weighed at the scale, priced at the counter. Only the $25 minimum is promised; paid at the counter.

services.name: Trailer fill
services.story: A trailer fill, priced at $90 from photos of the trailer. Sam OKs it; nothing taken; paid at the counter.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Per-push plan: driveway and front walk
services.story: The main story: a per-push plan. $55 a push for the driveway and front walk, plus $15 ice melt: $70, charged to the saved card when Rory texts DONE. No snow, no charge.

services.name: Per-push plan: driveway and front walk
services.story: The same per-push plan, with nothing taken. Rosie texts the $70 bill after each push.

services.name: Seasonal contract, Oct 15 to Apr 30
services.story: A seasonal contract, Oct 15 to Apr 30: $540 paid in full when booking. Every push at 2 inches or more is covered.

services.name: Gravel lane season (600 ft)
services.story: A 600-ft gravel lane with a turnaround, priced from Alex's photos at $640 for the season. Sam OKs it, both sign the contract, and it's paid in full.
